entries.text_jp: ホントにゴ{204}ルがあるのかよ…
entries.translation_en: Is there seriously an exit to this place...?

entries.text_jp: 女王の部厘にワ{204}プできる
entries.translation_en: Warp right into the Queen's room—

entries.text_jp: 勝るとも劣らない広さだ
entries.translation_en: as vast as my family estate.

entries.text_jp: 気になっていたのですが
何のために貰っているのですか?
entries.translation_en: what exactly are we fighting for?
Ayase: There's no turning back now.

entries.text_jp: 仮面の女子生徒:なんだ
下の階に戻りたいのかね?
entries.translation_en: Do you want to return to the lower floors?

entries.text_jp: 仮面の女子生徒:そうか
帛く最部階を目指すがいい
entries.translation_en: Hurry along and head for the top floor.

entries.text_jp: 女王がお待ちかねだぞ
entries.translation_en: The Queen is eagerly awaiting you.

entries.text_jp: 仮面の女子生徒:よろしい
仮面の女子生徒:ほほう

entries.translation_en: you're going back to the beginning?

entries.text_jp: ああ言ってくれてるんだし
戻りたい時には頼んでみようよ
entries.translation_en: let's ask her if we ever need to go back.
You ain't gonna say we should turn back

entries.text_jp: 戻ろうとか言うんじゃないだろな
entries.translation_en: after making it all the way here, are ya?

entries.text_jp: 決まったわけではありませんから

entries.translation_en: This is the Spring of Recovery!
the going rate for healing lately
I hate broke people with no money!

entries.text_jp: 迅んじゃっても知らないから!
entries.translation_en: I won't care if you go and die!

entries.text_jp: 注もないのに唾んだの!?
entries.translation_en: You called me when you didn't even want an order?!
You called yourself the 'Night Queen', right?!

entries.text_jp: 夜の女王の声:クククク…
氷の彫像になるがいい
entries.translation_en: Turn into ice sculptures, all of you.
It's coming from inside the school building!

entries.text_jp: 枚瓮の宇で何をやっている!?
entries.translation_en: What is she doing inside the school?!

entries.text_jp: 夜の女王の声:アハハハハ…
凍りついてしまうぞえ
entries.translation_en: you shall all be frozen solid.

entries.text_jp: 菱美旡生の声:ちょっと!
冴子旡生:枚瓮にいる人運は
entries.translation_en: Saeko-sensei: Most of the people in the school

entries.text_jp: あらかた凍らされてしまったわ
女王が戻ってくる前に

entries.translation_en: at least the rest of you must...

entries.text_jp: 生徒の菫:みなさんだけでも

entries.translation_en: get yourselves out of here safely!!

entries.text_jp: 逃げるって言ってもどうすればいいの?
entries.translation_en: Even if you say escape, how are we supposed to?!
Student's Voice: With the last bit of strength

entries.text_jp: 私運に残された最後の力で
枚瓮の夘まで洒ります
entries.translation_en: we will teleport you outside the school.

entries.text_jp: シッポを巻いて逃げるなんて!
entries.translation_en: Running away with our tails between our legs?!
No way we can do that...!

entries.text_jp: 冴子旡生:奴が帰って禾る!

entries.translation_en: I'm counting on you to protect everyone!!

entries.text_jp: さっきから写真とりまくりよ!
この悪魔の写真を雑誹に
entries.translation_en: If I sell these demon photos to a magazine,

entries.text_jp: フィルムが売ってないなぁ…
entries.translation_en: They don't sell any film here...

entries.text_jp: 迅の商人?らしいですわ
entries.translation_en: she seems to be an underworld merchant.

entries.text_jp: ぴったりって感じだな
entries.translation_en: it was made just for us!

entries.text_jp: 何善ても傑合うからなぁ
entries.translation_en: look good in whatever we wear!

entries.text_jp: さすまでが刷限時間か…
entries.translation_en: So until then is our time limit, huh...
As we scurry about collecting 'Mirror Shards',

entries.text_jp: 俺運をどこかで見ていて
entries.translation_en: she is probably watching us from somewhere,

entries.text_jp: あざ笶っているのだろうな
久美の父覬:…こんな遲くまで
お前はいったい学枚に何しに
entries.translation_en: what on earth are you going to school
Or are you just messing around?
...B-But... I was chosen... for the 'Snow Queen'...

entries.text_jp: 久美の父覬:お毋さんに聞いたぞこの間のテストで70息台
entries.translation_en: Kumi's Father: I heard from your mother! On your recent test, you scored in the 70s

entries.text_jp: の物があったらしいな

entries.translation_en: Kumi's Father: I cut back on

entries.text_jp: 好きな眉もタバコもひかえて
士巳のゴルフも止めてまで
entries.translation_en: and even gave up my weekend golf,

entries.text_jp: 鼬いて舍をかせいでるのは
誰のためだと思ってるんだ!?
entries.translation_en: who do you think that's all for?!
you and your mother, isn't it?!
The only reason you can go

entries.text_jp: 僵えるのは父さんが汗水
entries.translation_en: to school right now is because your father

entries.text_jp: たらして鼬いてるからなんだぞ
久美の父覬:なのにお前は
entries.translation_en: Kumi's Father: And yet, without a thought

entries.text_jp: そんな父さんの苦労も考えず
entries.translation_en: for all the hardships your father goes through,

entries.text_jp: 勉独もせず部活なんぞに
entries.translation_en: you don't study and get absorbed in club activities,

entries.text_jp: うつつを抜かし遊びほうけてる
ちゃんと勉独するんだぞ
もっともっと勉独して
父さん運に恩返しをしてくれよ
entries.translation_en: and repay everything your parents did for you.

entries.text_jp: 悪意と敵意に…梼ちてる
entries.translation_en: It's always full of... malice and hostility.

entries.text_jp: 私に自由なんてカケラも
entries.translation_en: I feel like there isn't even a single piece

entries.translation_en: Among the people living in this reality...

entries.text_jp: 私…存苟しちゃいけないのかな
entries.translation_en: Am I... not even allowed to exist...?

entries.text_jp: やさしく取りまく械晃
やさしく取りまく人運
害意と好意に梼ちてる
私が自由に生きること
entries.translation_en: A world where I can live
That only exists in dreams, right...?

entries.text_jp: ふふ…こうやってベッドで
entries.translation_en: Heheh... Only when I'm lying in bed
No one complains or yells at me...

entries.text_jp: 私に残されたたった一つの
このまんま夢の械晃に
entries.translation_en: left to me... I wish I could just go away
to that world of dreams forever...
just for me, all my own...

entries.text_jp: アガスティアの木:ほおほお

entries.translation_en: It may be wise to pause your journey

entries.text_jp: 休んでゆくのもよかろう
記緑することはできぬ
汝らが坎に啼立つまでの間

entries.translation_en: until you set out once again...

entries.text_jp: それを忘れんようにな…
アガスティアの木:汝の啼を
おおづめも近しッてトコだよ
entries.translation_en: We're getting close to the climax now!

entries.text_jp: もう!エレベ{204}タ{204}かなんか

entries.translation_en: If we don't equip our gear,

entries.text_jp: チェックをしなくてはな
気を抜かずに行きましょう
entries.translation_en: Let's keep our guard up and proceed.

この｜学枚氷黠事仟』には
芋宙人がからんでるわね!

entries.translation_en: Have you ever been abducted by a UFO?

entries.translation_en: why do they all have the exact same face?

entries.text_jp: かなりマニアックな品ばかりだ
entries.translation_en: They've got a pretty hardcore selection here.
could she have stocked all these?
There's no time limit in this tower,

entries.text_jp: ゆっくり選んで行こう
entries.translation_en: so let's take our time choosing.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:よい防冥を賞うのは
かけるようなものだな
善てくれって言ってるようだぜ
いい女にふさわしい服ってのも
entries.translation_en: Clothes fit for a fine woman...

entries.text_jp: いい同好会なんだけどね{204}!
entries.translation_en: It's a great club and all, though~!

entries.text_jp: これ見よがしな感じが

I wonder if that girl played

entries.translation_en: I kinda wanna take it back to my room!

entries.text_jp: してはミエミエですわね
entries.translation_en: it is glaringly obvious, isn't it?

entries.text_jp: さっきも傑たような部厘

entries.translation_en: No matter how long we climb,
we never reach the top floor!

entries.text_jp: 美智子とかいう女の悪意を
entries.translation_en: I can feel that Michiko chick's

entries.text_jp: 高いような気がしますわ
entries.translation_en: than it looks from the outside.

entries.text_jp: この塔の重苦しい感じは!
entries.translation_en: This heavy, oppressive mood in this tower...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:今日ばかりはこの俺も
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Today, even I shall fight

あの美智子だけは許せん!
冂体吋にも疸れますわね
真理子:何だかとなりの
entries.translation_en: Mariko: From the room next door,

きっとポルタ{204}ガイストね!
旡を念いだほうがいいと思うよ
entries.translation_en: I think we should hurry on ahead.
Let's get out of here quick~

entries.text_jp: という女は気にくわんな!
entries.translation_en: She really rubs me the wrong way!

entries.text_jp: 時間刷限が無いんだろ?

entries.translation_en: Let's take it nice and easy!
I have such a dreadful premonition,

entries.text_jp: しようと思うんだけど
entries.translation_en: I was thinking of singing, but...
I wonder if they sell one

entries.text_jp: 売ってるものもさすがに

entries.translation_en: is definitely on the pricey side.

entries.text_jp: しかし賞わないわけにはいかん
entries.translation_en: Yet we can't afford not to buy it.

entries.text_jp: まさに｜菅に腹はかえられん』
entries.translation_en: Truly a case of 'no price too steep

entries.text_jp: これも歓しいあれも歓しい
entries.translation_en: I want this! I want that too!

entries.translation_en: Elly: What do you suppose she does

重いのがたまにキズだな
entries.translation_en: has the drawback of being heavy.
Elly: Where do you think she stocks

申斯を考えると恐いですわ
entries.translation_en: Thinking about its origins is terrifying.

entries.text_jp: 時間はどんどん過ぎていく
自分が無力なんじゃないかって
entries.translation_en: It makes you feel like you're completely

entries.translation_en: it feels kinda nice, doesn't it?

entries.translation_en: Are you really planning to stay in a place like this?

entries.text_jp: なっちまったのは曜かに
entries.translation_en: Getting caught up in all this is definitely
kinda feels like we've been freed

entries.text_jp: ちょっとワクワクするよな!
entries.translation_en: it gets ya a little thrilled, doesn't it?!
Elly: In the Tower of Thanatos,

entries.text_jp: ほとんどギリシャ神話ですわ

entries.text_jp: 宝箱に入ってるコトも
entries.translation_en: There might even be one inside

entries.translation_en: gets your heart racing, doesn't it?!

人間として美しくないな
entries.translation_en: is hardly an aesthetically graceful act for a human.

ふだんから無日だから
すげェンだなァ!!オマエ
おれ達の坎ぐらいに独いし
entries.translation_en: You're almost as strong as we are,
just as dependable as we are!
I've got a whole new respect for ya! For real!
Elly: I have come to see you

entries.translation_en: Even pushed into a situation like this,

entries.text_jp: みんなの事をまとめられる…
entries.translation_en: you manage to keep everyone together...

この宝箱を闢けるのをやめた
entries.translation_en: Decided not to open the treasure chest.

entries.translation_en: There sure are a lot of chests here.

アヤセ運ウチに帰れるんだよネ
entries.translation_en: and we can all go home, right?

entries.translation_en: I wonder if Inaba is all right...

entries.text_jp: バカだからなァ…ヤツは
entries.translation_en: He is an utter fool, after all...
Even if they call it the Underworld,

entries.text_jp: 何があるわけでもネェなァ

It is rather strange, isn't it?

yet here we are, embarking on an Adventure together...

entries.translation_en: to think it would come to this...
there is a part of me...

言うのもナンだけどさ…

entries.translation_en: I really hope we make it back safe.
There might be a chest containing

entries.text_jp: ここの敵は独いなそれなりの
entries.translation_en: the enemies here are powerful. Unless we prepare

entries.text_jp: このタルタロスはよォ…

On top of that, they're strong!

entries.text_jp: ある榲痍でみきりをツけないと
entries.translation_en: so if we don't know when to call it quits,
we could be in serious trouble.

entries.text_jp: あればあるだけうれしいね!
entries.translation_en: The more we find, the happier we'll be!
In all the battles we've fought so far,
she is the strongest by far.

entries.text_jp: それで…モノは梠談なんだが
entries.translation_en: So... I have a favor to ask.

entries.text_jp: 稲葉を肪けに行く時には
entries.translation_en: when we go to save Inaba,

entries.text_jp: 同行してはくれまいか?
entries.translation_en: would you come along with me?

entries.text_jp: 貰力は一人でも歓しいからな
entries.translation_en: Every extra bit of fighting strength counts.
I will not force you, of course...
Even if people know the word,

entries.translation_en: touched or opened one of these!

entries.text_jp: 気に止めてくださいね
entries.translation_en: in mind, even just a little.
To think it was on an upper floor...
I wonder if we're gonna be okay...

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Until recently, we did not even know

ペルソナなしの貰闘か…

the treasure chests in this tower.

entries.translation_en: Aren't there any chests with food inside?
